articles.summary: SAVANNAH, Ga. , Oct. 29, 2014 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Citi Trends, Inc. (Nasdaq:CTRN) today announced details for the release of its results for the third quarter ending November 1, 2014 . Citi Trends plans to release its earnings for the third quarter before the market opens on Tuesday, November 25,
articles.title: Citi Trends Sets Date for Third Quarter Earnings Release and Conference Call
